bookingClasses.description: Information relating to the Passenger Reservations Booking Designator (PRBD) and Meals.

freightClasses.description: Indicates the type of cargo that can be loaded onto the equipment.

restrictions.description: Information provided by a carrier to specify restrictions on carrying traffic or limitations to the carriage of traffic.

planeChangeWithoutAircraftChange.description: True/False value showing if there is an equipment change enroute where the IATA Aircraft Type code is the same on each leg.

onTimePerformance.description: Represents on time indicator and delay and cancelation performance.

inFlightServices.description: Denotes the use of in-flight services in relation to the IATA standard.

automatedCheckIn.description: Identifies if the carrier offers automated check‑in for the flight leg.

electronicTicketing.description: Used to identify if a flight leg is an electronic ticketing candidate.

secureFlightIndicator.description: Present when legal requirement to disclose full Secure Flight passenger data for U.S. flights.

governmentApproval.description: Marker to show service is subject to government approval.

statusDetails.description: Details about flight status per leg.

seatingCapacity.description: Represents actual and predicted seating capacity.

serviceSuffix.description: The operational suffix supplied by the carrier.

flightNumber.description: The numeric part of the flight number.

sequenceNumber.description: Sequence of stopping points starting at 0.

departure.description: Departure airport, terminal, date, time, etc.

arrival.description: Arrival airport, terminal, date, time, etc.

aircraftType.description: Denotes the equipment type in use.

segmentInfo.description: Number of stops and intermediate airports.

originalFlight.description: Link to the original scheduled flight.
